FN-11DS1ZZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 477
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative James Lomax
Commissions
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/23/2026
House Bill 477 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Department of Workforce by
an undetermined amount dependent on any reimbursement paid by the department for any
additional members added to the Alabama Workforce Board or the state's regional workforce
boards, pursuant to this bill.
According to the department, the department does not reimburse members for expenses.
